_comment: Families of property names that mean the same quantity, so the method history (#210) and planning reuse (#217, #218) file them together. Acceptance-metric names come from the LLM and vary run to run: aspirin solubility was filed as aqueous_solubility_at_25c, aqueous_solubility_log_mol_per_l and aqueous_solubility_25c. Each family is a regex matched against the normalized key (lower case, words joined by _); the first match wins. A key no family matches is used as it is. Read by modules/16_agent_mesh_control_plane/statemachine.py and runner/method_history.py.
